name: performance review of the working tree

acceptance: scores every performance sub-scale 1-5 with a reason
every issue is marked with its conformance case or judgment-only
the repo under review is unchanged

expect: conformance.json exists and is the output of `pmos eval --framework performance --json` (its cases all have owner performance)
report.md has a Verdict section answering "Is it optimized for speed, cost and quality of output?" with a 1-5 score and a one-line reason for each of: speed, cost and quality
report.md ranks its top issues by severity (High, then Medium, then Low), and every issue cites at least one path:line
every issue ends with `Coverage:` naming a case from conformance.json with its pass/fail result, or `judgment-only`; no named case is missing from conformance.json
the Conformance section's pass/fail counts match conformance.json exactly
report.md has Quick wins and What's already good sections
report.md includes a hop count and the model tier per agent run for at least one multi-step workflow (e.g. sprint planning), traced to the mode's SKILL.md and roles.yaml
git status of the repo under review is the same before and after (verify-clean passed); nothing outside outputs/<id>/ was written
the result has status done, no actions, and a summary under 80 words with the scores
